claude.result:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what was implemented:

## Changes Made

**1. Weekly Cycle Support** (`src/cycles.js`)
- Added `WEEK: 'weekly'` to the CYCLE object
- Set monthly cost calculation: price × 52 ÷ 12 (rounded to nearest cent)
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly cycles (adds 7 days each time)

**2. CLI Updates** (`bin/subtrack.js`)
- Added support for `--every week` option
- Updated error messages to include 'week' as valid option
- Added 'week' and 'weekly' aliases to the EVERY object

**3. Bug Fix** (`src/renewals.js`)
- Fixed sorting to use chronological date order instead of lexicographic label order (was causing incorrect ordering across month boundaries)

**4. Tests** (comprehensive coverage)
- CLI test verifying `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` works
- Cycle tests for weekly cost calculations and 7-day renewal tracking
- Renewals test for weekly subscriptions in the upcoming list

## Verification

All 38 tests pass. The implementation correctly handles:

| Weekly Price | Monthly Equivalent |
|---|---|
| €12.00 | €52.00 |
| €59.90 | €259.56 |
| €25.00 | €108.33 |

Users can now add weekly subscriptions with `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week`, and subtrack will:
- Display the monthly equivalent cost everywhere
- Track renewals every 7 days from the `--since` date
- Include weekly plans in `subtrack renewals` output
